facts.value: Economic Spanish (A-B-C-D)
Every semester, one course is offered in rotation. All elective modules have the same difficulty level (target level C1.1 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages).
Preliminary admission for the qualification section of the Bachelor's examination according to § 9 paragraph 5.
There is a two-stage application procedure with different deadlines. You must participate in both stages and pass the Online Qualifying Test!
Registration deadline: September 21, 2026 – October 5, 2026 via QIS.
Exam registration and deregistration deadline: October 8, 2026 – October 21, 2026 via QIS.

The successful completion of the Online Qualifying Test in Spanish on September 28, 2026 from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM at CEFR level B 2.2, which takes place at the beginning of each semester if no Bachelor elective module in Economic Spanish has been successfully completed.
